cover.title: What Makes It Great? with Rob Kapilow
cover.subtitle: Anything But Standard: The Music of Ella Fitzgerald and Oscar Peterson
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: "Rob Kapilow has an exceptional gift for illuminating music's secrets without diminishing its magic." The Boston Globe

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: -- 18 of 57 -- Rob Kapilow, a live band, and two vocalists demonstrate the unique power of interpretation— exploring how Ella Fitzgerald and Oscar Peterson transformed popular film and Broadway songs into enduring jazz standards.
body: Rob Kapilow's delightfully illuminating What Makes It Great? programs are a masterclass in composer magic: a sudden spark, a fascinating touch, an unexpected swerve. In Anything But Standard, Kapilow demonstrates the unique power of interpretation. Alongside a live band and two vocalists, he'll consider three songs in detail, showing how the singular vocalist Ella Fitzgerald and jazz pianist Oscar Peterson transformed popular film and Broadway songs into jazz standards. Rob shares what makes a lifelong toolkit in listening for the spirit and rhythm of jazz, and implores audiences to experience the alchemy themselves.
